issues.display_title: Issue #3365: Slicing System Update New Layout
issues.main_description_html:
✂️ Slicing — System Update (New Layout)

Slice the System Update page UI into the new pages-new flow to match the Figma design.

🎨 Design: TBD — Figma frame link to be added.

Re-slice of the old layout (see #2641, #2642, #2643) into the new pages-new structure.

Scope

  • Build the system update list layout: entries (title, version, publish date, status badge), the "Add System Update" CTA, and pagination per the Figma frame.
  • Include the add/edit form layout (title, version, release notes editor, schedule/publish toggle) as designed.
  • Split the page into child components (list, row/card, form, empty state).
  • Standalone + ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush + Tailwind 4 / Zard UI; semantic tokens (light/dark). No any.
  • Static/dummy data acceptable for slicing — API wiring is a separate task.

🧪 Test scenario (for QA)

Pre: open Support → System Update.

  1. Layout match — list rows, status badges, and the Add CTA match Figma spacing/typography.
  2. Form layout — add/edit form fields, labels, helper text and Save/Cancel placement match the design.
  3. States — loading skeleton, empty state, and long release notes render as designed.
  4. Responsive — at 375px list and form go full-width per the mobile frame; no horizontal scroll; touch targets ≥44px.
  5. Light/Dark + no errors — both themes legible; no console errors.

Acceptance: matches Figma (list + form, desktop + mobile); loading/empty states correct; light + dark; no console errors; no any.

issues.display_title: Issue #3381: Create Post Success Dialog Flow
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by develoepr

screen-capture.50.webm

Create Post Success Dialog Flow

1. Overview

Feature Name: Create Post Publishing Success Flow

Purpose:
Provide clear feedback when a user publishes a new post using a centered
modal dialog with backdrop overlay.

The flow contains three UI transitions:

  1. Publishing Process
  2. Post Created / Redirect Preparation
  3. Success Confirmation Actions

2. User Flow

User clicks Publish Post

        ↓

State 1: Creating your post...

        ↓

State 2: Almost done / Redirecting

        ↓ (wait 2 seconds)

State 3: Post created successfully

2.1 UI

3. Modal Specification

Container

  • Position: Center screen
  • Width: 420px desktop
  • Mobile width: calc(100vw - 32px)
  • Border radius: 20px
  • Background: White
  • Shadow: Large soft elevation

Backdrop Overlay

rgba(15,23,42,0.65)

Behavior: - Disable background interaction - Prevent page scrolling -
Maintain visual context of previous page

4. Transition 1 - Publishing State

Title

Creating your post...

Description

Please wait, we're publishing your post.

Loader

Circular loading animation.

Checklist

  • Uploading content...
  • Processing location data...
  • Saving to server...
  • Finalizing your post...

Active step: - Purple indicator - Animated progress

Inactive step: - Gray outline indicator

5. Transition 2 - Completed State

Displayed after post creation succeeds.

Timing

Remain visible for:

2 seconds

Content

Title:

Almost done!

Description:

Your post has been created successfully.

Progress:

Redirecting in 2 seconds...

Animation: - Loader transforms into check icon - Fade transition - Scale
animation

6. Transition 3 - Success State

Icon

Green success check animation.

Title

Post created successfully!

Description

Your post is now live and ready to be seen.

7. Action Buttons

Primary CTA

Label:

View Created Post

Action:

Navigate to created post detail page.

Secondary CTA

Label:

Share Post

Action:

Open native share dialog.

Third CTA

Label:

Back to Home

Action:

Navigate to home page.

8. Component Structure

CreatePostPage

 └── PublishButton

      └── CreatePostSuccessDialog

            ├── Backdrop

            ├── PublishingState

            ├── CompletedState

            └── SuccessState

9. State Management Example

setDialogState("publishing")

await createPost()

setDialogState("completed")

setTimeout(() => {
  setDialogState("success")
}, 2000)

10. Animation Rules

Modal Entrance

Duration:

250ms

Effect:

opacity 0 → 1
scale 0.95 → 1

Transition Between States

Duration:

300ms

Effect:

fade out previous state
fade in next state

11. Error Handling

If publishing fails:

State:

error

Display:

Title:

Unable to create post

Message:

Something went wrong. Please try again.

Button:

Retry

12. Accessibility

Requirements:

  • Keyboard focus trap
  • Screen reader announcement
  • Accessible button labels
  • ESC handling when safe

13. Acceptance Criteria

  • Modal appears centered\
  • Backdrop overlay blocks background interaction\
  • Loader appears immediately after publish click\
  • Three transitions run sequentially\
  • Success state appears after 2 seconds\
  • User can view created post\
  • User can share post\
  • User can return home\
  • Animations do not cause layout shift
